Name: Castle View Hideaway
Address: Rua da Bempostinha 64, 5º dto, Arroios, 1150-099 Lisboa
Tips: HOST ISABELLY RECEIVES YOU AT 12:00 - agreed early arrival, standard window is 16:00-22:00. Online check-in AND the guest registration form are both submitted - no paperwork at the door, but have the four passports to hand anyway. Land 09:55, Metro Red to Alameda then Green to Anjos, at the door ~11:20 - kill the 40 min at a café, do not loiter on the landing. Drop all six bags here then leave for Belém. Phone +351 925 360 038 - message her if the flight slips.

Name: Pastéis de Belém
Tips: Original 1837 recipe. Join the takeaway line, not the sit-down queue. MOVED TO THE 14:20 LUNCH BLOCK (was 12:15) because the 12:00 apartment handover pushes Belém back. Eat hot on the wall outside.

Name: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
Cost Range: 18 EUR cloister / ~9 EUR youth 13-24 with ID (church free)
Tips: BOOKED - order 38185413, paid. Now planned for 13:00. VERIFY THE ACTUAL SLOT TIME ON THE ORDER BEFORE AUG 23 - the 12:00 Isabelly handover shifts Belém ~45 min later, so if the slot is 12:30 or earlier ask her for 11:30 instead. Closed Mondays. Free church keeps Sunday hours 14:00-17:00 - swing back at 14:00. Manueline masterpiece, tomb of Vasco da Gama.

Name: Padrão dos Descobrimentos
Cost Range: 10 EUR (lift to roof); youth rate - ask at desk
Tips: 52m limestone prow. Best single view over Belém. Daily 10:00-19:00. If running late, view from outside - the 16:00 Tower slot is the fixed point.

Name: Torre de Belém
Tips: BOOKED - order 38185394, paid, Aug 23 16:00 slot - be at the gate 15:55. Reopened 26 May 2026 after 13-month restoration; strict timed entry (60 people per 30 min). Closed Mondays. Find the carved rhinoceros on the north bastion.

Name: MAAT
Tips: White wave-roofed museum. Free rooftop climb over the river on the walk back from the Tower. Galleries closed Tuesdays (rooftop always open).

Name: Rua Augusta / Arco da Rua Augusta
Tips: Pedestrian spine of Baixa. Climb the arch ~19:40 for golden-hour views (sunset ~20:20).

Name: Praça do Comércio
Tips: Vast riverfront square - best light 20:00-20:20. Grab a ginjinha from a nearby counter on the way.

Name: Time Out Market Lisboa
Tips: 26 curated stalls under one roof - everyone picks their own. Sun-Wed to midnight. Watch bags in the crush.

Name: Santini
Tips: Lisbon classic since 1949. Lemon, pistachio, torrone flavours. Post-dinner stop.

Name: Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara
Address: Rua de São Pedro de Alcântara, 1200 Lisboa
Tips: Castle lit up across the valley at night - best after dinner. Glória funicular alongside is closed; walk up (5 min, steep).
